title: Token Stream Compressor
description: Compress a lowercase string by replacing every consecutive group of equal characters with the character followed by its group length.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the string.
outputFormat: Print the compressed string without spaces.
hints: Track the start of each consecutive group and count how long it continues.

examples.explanation: The groups are aaa, bb and c.
Each consecutive group is represented by its character and count.
